onSuccessCallback.description: Callback when the password is successfully updated. Use to redirect users, show custom notifications, or trigger post-update flows.

onErrorCallback.description: Callback when password update fails. Use to display custom error messages, log errors, or trigger recovery flows.

UpdatePassword.description: The UpdatePassword container continues the process of resetting the user's password that began in the [ResetPassword container](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/user-auth/containers/reset-password/). The user clicks a link in an email to navigate to the UpdatePassword container, where they can enter a new password.

onSuccessCallback.description: Callback when sign-up completes successfully. Use to redirect users, show email confirmation messaging, or trigger post-registration flows.

onErrorCallback.description: Callback when sign-up fails. Use to display custom error messages, log errors, or trigger recovery flows.

SignUp.description: The SignUp container provides a form where the user enters the details required to create a new account. The execution of this form can vary, depending on how Commerce is configured:

onSuccessCallback.description: Callback when sign-in completes successfully. Use to redirect users, update application state, or trigger post-login flows.

onErrorCallback.description: Callback when sign-in fails. Use to display custom error messages, log errors, or trigger recovery flows.

onSignUpLinkClick.description: Callback when the user clicks the sign-up link. Use to navigate to registration, open a modal, or customize the sign-up flow.

SignIn.description: The SignIn container helps render different screens that enable the customer to log in to an account. The container supports multiple scenarios, including standard logins for existing accounts and for accounts that are process of being confirmed.

onSuccessCallback.description: Callback when the password reset request completes successfully. Use to redirect users, show confirmation messaging, or trigger follow-up flows.

onErrorCallback.description: Callback when the password reset request fails. Use to display custom error messages, log errors, or trigger recovery flows.

ResetPassword.description: The ResetPassword container renders a dialog that initiates the process of resetting the user's password. The user must provide their email address to receive a password reset link.

AuthCombine.description: The AuthCombine container renders a dialog that combines the sign-in, sign-up, and reset password forms. The user can switch between the forms using the provided links.

SuccessNotification.description: The SuccessNotification container displays a message to the user after a successful action, such as signing up or updating a password. The SignIn, SignUp, and UpdatePassword containers can pass the SuccessNotification container as a slot.
